title: [3.0-beta7] NS Client doesn't sync extended boluses
body:
Version `3.0-beta7` - booth aaps and nsclient, nightscout: `14.2.4`, Dana R pump

I noticed that at least the extended boluses tab of the treatments is empty on nsclient side. Check images bellow - left side is AAPS, right side is nsclient. The difference can be seen also on main graph of nsclient. And probably also `IOB` shown on nsclient is affected by this. Last screenshot is from nightscout where those extended boluses are also shown.


And another minor issue on nsclient side - I'm unable to hide the fiasp-oref insulin tab. It's not part of configuration as was in previous version.
